Image 1 is the floor plan of a room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Image 2 is the front view of the same room (the establishing view), taken from the centre of the front wall facing the back wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this same room, empty of people, from a new camera position: the back view: the camera stands at the centre of the back wall, at eye level, facing the front wall, turned 180 degrees from Image 2, so the left wall is at the right edge of the frame and the right wall at its left edge. Turn the camera for real: this view must not show the back wall's furniture head-on unless it is the wall being faced. Keep every wall, door, window, piece of furniture, material, colour and light exactly as Image 1 and Image 2 show them, seen from this new side; the room layout and furniture placement exactly match Image 1. Location: JI RAN'S OFFICE. Sleek, spacious contemporary executive office of a design company, in warm walnut, white and grey. A large walnut desk is covered with architectural plans, wood samples, a metal figurine and a pour-over coffee station. Behind it stands a black leather executive chair. To one side are a lounge area of black leather sofas and armchairs around a white marble coffee table, and a wall sign reading 'JUST DO IT'. The door is on the side wall facing the desk, with open space in front of the desk for standing visitors. Floor-to-ceiling windows behind the desk let in bright, soft daylight from behind and to the left of the desk. Warm recessed ceiling spots and a brass desk lamp fill in from above.

Avoid: people, readable text, logos, watermark, any door or window the description does not name.
